messages:
maria: heads up — Globex SI sent their 'usage' webhook draft. they included session_count and an array of feature_flags. unclear how we should map to our billable units (tokens/embeddings). can someone weigh in?

matt: can you paste the payload sample?

maria: sure — here's the minimal example they sent:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_987",
  "window_start": "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-03-15T23:59:59Z",
  "session_count": 42,
  "features": ["chat", "embeddings"],
  "usage_meta": { "session_duration_ms": 120000 }
}
```

sara: quick take — Redwood bills by token/embedding units. session_count is useful for analytics but not billable unless they map to tokens. we need either token_count or a deterministic conversion. otherwise we can't reconcile.

kevin: agreed. if Globex insists on session_count we need a mapping doc that defines how many tokens per session for each feature flag and what sampling heuristics are allowed. we should push for token_count in the webhook.

matt: +1. also need signature HMAC and timestamp to avoid replay. do they include a dedupe_id?

maria: they don't currently. their notes mention idempotency by (customer_id, window_start).

partner-billing-bot: webhook_delivery_failed: POST https://ingest.redwood.com/partner/globex/usage  -> 415 Unsupported Media Type. payload_type: application/json; charset=utf-8

sara: hmm the 415 suggests content-type mismatch from their test harness — we should give them an exact contract: JSON schema, required fields, signature header (X-Redwood-Signature), and a sample success response.

kevin: propose we create a short acceptance checklist for Globex: 
- required: token_count OR approved conversion table per feature
- required: dedupe_id OR idempotency window + deterministic aggregation key
- required: X-Redwood-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) + X-Redwood-Ts
- optional: session_count for analytics
- schema version header: X-Redwood-Schema: v1

matt: add: timezone must be UTC ISO8601, numeric fields as integers, and arrays limited to 100 items. also rate limit note (100 reqs/min per partner) and 202/200 semantics for async ingestion.

maria: i'll draft the checklist and the sample payloads (good / bad). can you own publishing the schema to the partner portal, @kevin?

kevin: yep. i'll also add an example conversion table to the doc for cases where partners can't provide token_count. it'll include: feature->default_tokens_per_session and an acceptance test that maps a sample file to our billing pipeline and flags >5% variance.

sara: for reconciliation: we should require a daily summary report from Globex (CSV) that includes their claimed token_count and our ingest tx_id for cross-checking. if variances >1% we trigger a review. also log retention 180 days for reconciliations.

matt: operational notes: on our side, implement metric export: partner.claimed_tokens vs redwood.ingested_tokens so finance can auto-flag. also add trace id in response header: X-Redwood-Trace.

maria: timeline? Globex wants go/no-go next week for their SI rollout.

kevin: i can get schema and portal page up in 3 business days.

sara: i'll prepare the reconciliation checklist and variance thresholds by EOD tomorrow.

maria: i'll communicate the blocked items to Globex (token_count requirement, signature, schema header). i'll attach our sample payloads and the acceptance checklist when ready.

matt: I'll add the metric hooks and response headers in the ingestion service PR — target code review in 4 days.

maria: action items recap:
- maria: send Globex note + sample payloads (today)
- kevin: publish schema + conversion table + portal snippet (3 business days)
- sara: reconciliation runbook + variance thresholds (EOD tomorrow)
- matt: ingestion response headers + metrics instrument (PR in 4 days)

maria: thanks all — ping me in-thread with any questions. :thumbsup:

partner-billing-bot: webhook_verified: Globex staging signed payload accepted (200). delivery_id: dw_7c4b2

maria: great — i'll update Globex and ask for a full-day test with their SI on staging before go/no-go.

kevin: noted. will include an automated validation that rejects payloads where claimed token_count deviates >20% from conversion heuristics and returns 422 with a helpful message.

sara: FYI finance wants the reconciliation CSV column names to be: partner_id, window_start, window_end, claimed_token_count, redwood_ingested_tokens, variance_pct, reconciliation_note

matt: perfect. closing loop here, will post PR link when ready.
